About Nooks.ai

Nooks is an applied AI lab building revenue agents that power some of the fastest growing companies in the world. We build AI agents that operate across the full revenue lifecycle, from account strategy to prospect research and outreach. Building 0→1 has never been easier, but selling at the speed of the market remains the last frontier for AI. Our mission is to 10x every seller by automating the busywork so they can focus on what humans do best: closing deals.

Today, over 2000 customers power their revenue growth using Nooks, including Notion, HubSpot, Cursor, and Rippling. We've raised over 70M USD from top VCs like Kleiner Perkins, and we have more than tripled ARR each year for 3 years running.

Build the future of AI-powered work.

At Nooks, we're building AI agents that automate the most important function for every company: revenue generation.

Our customers use Nooks to build agents that research accounts, run outreach, and work deals across the whole revenue lifecycle. They trust us to deliver the infrastructure across text, voice, computer use, and data to power their inbound, outbound, and deal execution. Every day, thousands of users rely on Nooks to do the work that used to take entire teams of people.

Because every company in the world has a revenue function, we're still incredibly early in our product lifecycle, which means engineers have an outsized impact. You'll ship production code on your first day, own projects from idea to production, talk directly with our customers, and help define what building and maintaining AI-native enterprise software looks like.

If you want to spend your early career helping companies solve their hardest problems, building products people genuinely love, and working alongside a team that is high-intensity, high-trust, low-ego, and playing to win, we'd love to meet you. Early in your career, the environment you choose matters more than almost anything else.

What You'll Do

As a new graduate engineer, you'll work across the stack and collaborate closely with product, design, and customers to build features that ship quickly and make a measurable impact.

You'll



- Design, build, and ship using React, TypeScript, Node.js, and Python.
- Own projects from initial idea through deployment, monitoring, and iteration.
- Work directly with customers to understand their problems and turn feedback into product improvements.
- Build product that powers agent-building, real-time collaboration, enterprise-scale workflows and automations, and human-agent interaction.
- Improve the performance, reliability, and scalability of our platform.
- Low-latency voice AI on live calls and live coaching
- Work across the entire agent development lifecycle, from agent-building to simulations and evals to monitoring and feedback loops.
- Improve the efficiency and cost of our agents, through better agent design and context engineering.
- Write clean, maintainable code and contribute thoughtful feedback and review.

What We're Looking For

We're much more interested in how you think and the outcomes you are ambitious enough to drive than whether you've used every technology in our stack.

You'll Likely Be a Great Fit If You



- Are completing or recently completed a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field.
- Have built software and agents through internships, research, open source, startups, or personal projects.
- Have gotten stuck on something hard and found a way to push through.
- Care whether what you build matters to the people using it.
- Love learning new technologies and figuring out how to use them to solve problems for people. Experience with React, TypeScript, Node.js, or Python is a plus, but not required.
- Thrive in fast-moving environments where engineers take ownership and make product decisions.
- Able to collaborate with teammates, be truth-seeking and low-ego, and communicate technical ideas clearly.
- Can work from our San Francisco or Seattle offices.

How We Work



- Ownership. You’ll ship to production on your first day. From there, you'll progressively take ownership of larger features while pairing closely with experienced engineers, learning about our customer problems, product, and infrastructure. By the end of your first few months, you'll be expected to own both customer and product outcomes end-to-end. You’ll talk directly to customers, watch how they use what you built, and decide what to change.
- Customer Empathy. You’ll talk directly to customers, watch how they use what you built, and decide what to change.
- Intensity. We move fast because we’re intense about outcomes and building trust with our customers. If our product is not the best, we sprint to fix it.
- Agency. The ideas that can change the trajectory of a product or company can come from anywhere. 
- AI-native. We build agents, and we invest in their ability to give us the most leverage possible. You will be in an environment where you are constantly learning how to leverage agents to increase your craft and velocity.

Compensation & Benefits

Compensation for this role includes competitive base salary, meaningful equity, and comprehensive benefits. Our benefits package includes medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance, hybrid work, and unlimited paid time off. Benefits may vary based on location and are subject to change.

The base salary range for this role is $120,000 annual rate.

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

Nooks is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workforce. We believe in providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Nooks does not discriminate in hiring, promotion, compensation, or any other employment practices, and we are committed to ensuring a workplace that is free from discrimination, harassment, and retaliation. We encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply and join our team.

Our Vision: We make dreams possible.

Yes, we’re a student loan servicer. We’re also a technology company, idea incubator, start-up accelerator, and K-12 and higher education expert. At Nelnet, we’re so much more than what you think—and we’re just getting started. So, no matter what you want to do in life—build codes or build brands—we’re the best place to do it.

Join Nelnet as an intern and do real work that matters to our business. All Nelnet interns receive one-on-one mentorship, competitive pay, casual dress, flexible schedule, intern-specific programming, and meaningful work experience.

Apply to one of our internships today. Your career awaits.

Position Summary:

We’re looking for a curious and motivated Automation QA Intern to join our QA Engineering team for an 8‑month in‑person co‑op starting in January 2027. In this role, you’ll gain hands-on experience writing and testing automation scripts for real software projects. You’ll collaborate with QA engineers and developers in a supportive, DevOps‑driven environment that values learning, mentorship, and quality.

This internship is ideal for students building foundational automation and QA skills, offering guidance, real-world exposure, and the opportunity to grow within modern QA practices.

Compensation: $23/hr.

This is an in-office role based out of our Mississauga location with a requirement is to be in the office 5 days per week.

Additionally, this position requires the successful completion of a Government of Canada Reliability Clearance (PERC) as a condition of employment. Candidates must be eligible to obtain and maintain the required clearance throughout their employment.

This position is for an existing vacancy within our organization.

Key Responsibilities:



- Develop and maintain basic automated test scripts for web and API testing using tools such as Selenium, Playwright, or Postman, with guidance from QA engineers.
- Execute test scripts to validate new features and bug fixes across multiple environments.
- Log and track defects found during testing and collaborate with QA engineers and developers to troubleshoot and resolve issues.
- Review project requirements and test cases to understand testing scope and identify automation opportunities.
- Assist in updating and organizing test documentation, including test cases, test data, and test results.
- Learn and apply version control practices using Git to manage and update test scripts.
- Participate in team meetings and various ceremonies to gain exposure to Project and DevOps workflows.
- Support QA engineers in integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins).
- Actively seek feedback, ask questions, and contribute to a culture of continuous learning and quality improvement.

Required Qualifications:



- Currently enrolled in a Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related undergraduate program.
- Basic understanding of programming concepts (e.g., C#, JavaScript, Python, or Java), gained through coursework or personal projects.
- Hands-on experience writing simple scripts or test cases—through labs, assignments, or personal exploration.
- Ability to write, read, and debug simple code with support from the team.
- Familiarity with object-oriented programming principles and basic understanding of test frameworks or unit testing.
- Interest in software testing, automation, and quality assurance.
- Strong attention to detail and willingness to learn.
- Effective communication and collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications:



- Exposure to automation tools or frameworks (e.g., Selenium, Playwright).
- Familiarity with Git or other version control systems.

Learning Outcomes:



- Gain practical experience in automation testing and QA processes.
- Work with enterprise-level tools and CI/CD practices.
- Receive mentorship from experienced QA professionals.
- Contribute to meaningful projects that impact product quality.

Nelnet is committed to providing a welcoming and respectful workplace where all associates have the opportunity to succeed. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we ensure that all qualified applicants are considered for employment. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion/creed, national origin, gender, sex, marital status, age, disability, use of a guide dog or service animal, sexual orientation, military/veteran status, or any other status protected by federal, state, or local law. We value the unique contributions of every team member and believe that a positive work environment benefits everyone.

Qualified individuals with disabilities who require reasonable accommodations in order to apply or compete for positions at Nelnet may request such accommodations by contacting Corporate Recruiting at 402-486-5725 or corporaterecruiting@nelnet.net.

Nelnet is a Drug Free and Tobacco Free Workplace.

We may use automated or artificial intelligence enabled tools to assist with the initial review of applications, such as identifying relevant skills or experience. These tools are used to support human review and do not make hiring decisions. A recruiter reviews applications and determines which candidates move forward in the hiring process.
